**Chinese name:** 北方华创 (Běifāng Huáchuàng)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's largest semiconductor equipment maker, formed from the restructuring of Beijing Sevenstar Electronics and North Microelectronics — added to the US Entity List in the December 2024 action that named 140 Chinese semiconductor firms. H1 2026 revenue reached ¥20.161 billion (+24.9% year-on-year) with net profit of ¥3.37 billion (+5.05%), driven by rising market share in etch and deposition tools.
:::

## What does this firm supply?

Etch systems, deposition tools (CVD and PVD), thermal processing equipment, and wafer cleaning systems — alongside NAURA, AMEC, and Piotech helped raise China's global deposition-tool market share from roughly 2% to 7% between 2019 and 2024.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Equipment |
| **Segment** | Etch, Deposition, CMP |
| **Node Capability** | Advanced-node etch/deposition tools in volume use at SMIC and other mature-node fabs; not confirmed at leading-edge (sub-14nm) nodes |
| **Founded** | 2001 |
| **HQ** | Beijing |
| **Entity List** | Yes — US Commerce BIS |
